statutory_dues.text:
The Company does not have liability in respect of Service tax, Duty of excise, Sales tax and Value added tax during the year since effective 1 July 2017, these statutory dues has been subsumed into GST

According to the information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the records of the Company, in our opinion amounts deducted / accrued in the books of account in respect of undisputed statutory dues including Goods and Service Tax, Provident Fund, Employees State Insurance, Income-Tax, Duty of Customs or Cess or other statutory dues have generally been regularly deposited with the appropriate authorities.

According to the information and explanations given to us and on the basis of our examination of the records of the Company, there were no undisputed statutory dues as mentioned above in arrears as at 31st March, 2024 for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.

timeline.summary: Sadhana Nitrochem's board approved a ₹13.91 Cr preferential share issue and an increase in authorized capital to ₹305 Cr, subject to shareholder approval.
Sadhana Nitrochem filed its first monitoring agency report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹251.95 Cr utilized out of ₹263.53 Cr rights issue proceeds.
Sadhana Nitrochem held an Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on May 22, 2026, to consider capital increase, director appointments, and preferential share issuance.
Sadhana Nitrochem secured a ₹108 Cr long-term export supply contract from a Japanese multinational, pushing its order book above ₹200 Cr.
Sadhana Nitrochem clarified the preferential issue floor price at ₹2.05 per share while keeping the allotment price at ₹2.06.
CFO and President - Operations & Finance Vimal Jain resigned effective October 13, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹42.75 Cr (+1483.3% YoY), net profit ₹1.37 Cr (against a loss of ₹25.54 Cr a year earlier).
